title: Ouster Gemini 3D Detection at GSX 2026
summary: See how Ouster Gemini's 3D lidar platform is redefining physical security at GSX 2026, now deployed across 1,200+ sites covering 65 million square feet worldwide.
body_markdown:
**Constellis Booth**


Ouster Gemini AI was on show at the[Constellis](https://constellis.com/) booth, highlighting the[Ouster Gemini integration](https://investors.ouster.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ouster-announces-strategic-partnership-constellis-bring-physical) into Constellis's LEXSO operational intelligence platform.


LEXSO fuses data across multiple sensing modalities—including lidar, radar, thermal imaging, acoustic detection, and video analytics—into a unified real-time operating picture. Ouster Gemini serves as a foundational intelligence layer within LEXSO, processing high-density 3D spatial data to automate response protocols and drive physical AI security operations.
